k8s:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: prod
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: img:1
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          env:
            - name: E1
              value: "v1"
            - name: E2
              value: "has \"quote\""
          envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: creds
            - secretRef:
                name: db-creds
          volumeMounts:
            - name: secret-tls
              mountPath: /etc/tls
              readOnly: true
            - name: secret-certs
              mountPath: /etc/certs
              readOnly: true
            - name: secret-tls
              mountPath: /etc/tls2
              readOnly: true
      volumes:
        - name: secret-tls
          secret:
            secretName: tls
        - name: secret-certs
          secret:
            secretName: certs
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: bare
  namespace: default
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: bare
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: bare
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: bare
          image: nginx:latest
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80
